note: Files the Ono plugins write into a work repo and intend to be COMMITTED. The session closer never .gitignores these. Patterns are git-style globs relative to the repo root. 'neverCommit' lists plugin scratch files that land in the repo but must not be committed. Generated ledger/readiness files must never be edited, formatted or line-ending-normalized.

ono-mobile-dev-plugin.frontmatterDocs: Feature Analysis, Dev Plan and Task Breakdown have no fixed filename: any new .md whose YAML frontmatter has doc_schema_version + feature: is a planning doc → commit.
ono-mobile-dev-plugin.evidence: docs/task-state-contract.md:20, docs/bug-work-plan-contract.md:412, scripts/reference-integrity.ts:331; scratch is written outside the repo.

ono-project-inspector.evidence: skills/inspection-state/SKILL.md:52, docs/repo-knowledge-contract.md:11; .bak written in Version mode; the inspector never edits .gitignore.

ono-plugin-qa.repo: QA repo only (writes nothing into the code repo). The QA engineer commits by hand — the plugin's hook blocks Claude's commit/push there.
ono-plugin-qa.evidence: docs/qa-ledger-contract.md (hash-chained, 'QA reviews and commits ledger files by hand').

matrix-qa-plugin.repo: Matrix QA repo (matrix-qa.config.json). The QA engineer does all git writes.

spec-team-toolkit.note: Writes nothing into the repo by design (outputs are downloads / sandbox paths). If the employee saves specs into the repo (spac_*.md, dd_*.md, hld-draft.md, scope-list.md), ask before committing; the .html preview is scratch.

always.note: Secrets are never committed regardless of plugin.
